scope: Failure-only release diagnostic of the rejected 22b renderer-switch chain. Owner location outside the Zone is legal; the observed mismatch between its value and the old payload is the error.
observation: Z_CheckHeap: block 1853 tag 52 size 818176 payload 0x191db00: user 0x82ba18 holds 0x1400cc0, outside the arena
diagnostic_delta: Only the existing Z_CheckHeap owner-mismatch failure logger is exposed in release; original condition, I_Error, tags, headers and ZDEBUG=false retained.
